nphi.summary: Developed a self-sufficient bacteriology lab model for AMR surveillance, piloted in Assin Foso and Koro.

nphi.title: SYSVAC – Global registry of systematic reviews on vaccines

nphi.title: NiCaDe – NCDC capacity development for infectious disease preparedness

nphi.title: PASQUALE – Partnership to improve patient safety and quality of care

nphi.title: RegTrain – PharmTrain – Regulatory training and advice for pharmaceuticals

nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer regulatory capacity building for medicines against infectious diseases.

nphi.title: SeqMDRTB_NET – Sequencing against drug-resistant TB

nphi.title: Lassa-Nigeria – Rapid containment of Lassa fever and countermeasures

nphi.summary: Built Lassa sequencing pipeline and clinical trial sites for Lassa treatments in Nigeria.

nphi.title: WHO CC GOARN – Operationalisation of WHO Collaborating Centre for GOARN
nphi.with: GOARN at WHO; GOARN Outbreak Response Leadership Training Working Group
nphi.summary: Supported GOARN 2.0 strategy and Tier 3 leadership training.

nphi.title: PANDORA-ID-NET – Pan-African Network for Rapid Research, Response, Relief and Preparedness for Infectious Disease Epidemics
nphi.actor: Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale

nphi.title: Fiocruz – BNITM memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM)
nphi.summary: International cooperation MoU between Fiocruz and Germany's Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine on tropical and infectious disease research.

nphi.title: TuNDRA & TuNDRA PLUS – Real-time tracking of neglected bacterial diseases and resistance in Asia
nphi.with: Child Health Research Foundation; Kumudini Hospital Mirzapur (Bangladesh); COMRU, Angkor Hospital for Children (Cambodia); OUCRU (Vietnam); Wellcome Sanger Institute; Big Data Institute (UK); International Vaccine Institute (South Korea)
nphi.summary: Hospital-based genomic surveillance of bacterial infections and AMR in South/Southeast Asia, later with RSV.

nphi.title: IDEA – Identification of emerging agents in Sri Lanka
nphi.with: University of Colombo; North Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka)
nphi.summary: Strengthened diagnostics to detect emerging infectious diseases and investigate viral outbreaks.

nphi.title: ORDER-HC – Maintaining routine health care during epidemics

nphi.summary: Studied how to keep routine care running during epidemics in West Africa and informed health worker curricula.

nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: TRICE – Training on investigation and control of epidemics
nphi.with: Centre Muraz; CHU Sourô Sanou (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké; Université Alassane Ouattara; LANADA (Côte d'Ivoire); INRB; Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); NICD; University of Pretoria (South Africa)

nphi.title: RegTrain – VaccTrain – Regulatory training for vaccines and biomedicines

nphi.summary: Built regulatory capacity on vaccine authorisation, pharmacovigilance and clinical trial oversight.

nphi.title: ARGOS – Antimicrobial resistance global surveillance

nphi.summary: Installed blood culture diagnostics and sentinel AMR surveillance in African hospitals.

nphi.title: BloodTrain – Regulation of blood and blood products

nphi.summary: Supported regulatory structures for blood safety and quality incl. crisis readiness.

nphi.title: D:APS – Deployment: assessment, planning and support

nphi.summary: Trained national drug QC lab staff in ISO 17025 quality management to detect substandard anti-infectives.

nphi.title: GETPrepaReD – Emergency trainings and support for outbreak preparedness

nphi.summary: Research and training on prudent antibiotic use, pharmacogenetics and TDM to curb AMR.

nphi.title: AfroLabNet – African laboratory network

nphi.summary: Strengthened diagnostic labs in West Africa and mobile lab units for crisis use in Africa and Europe.

nphi.summary: Indo-German special arrangement from 1976, renewed 1990 with an addendum in 2005, on biomedical research.
